system.description:
When making a ranged attack against a target with Cover, you can choose to reduce the benefit of that target's Cover by one step, from Improved Cover to Cover, or Cover to no Cover.

You deal only half damage with this attack.

prerequisite.text: Knack talent, and Lucky Shot talent
